first_step_test: The squat bulb outline and narrow upper neck give a clear final-position envelope with room for ribs and a separate loose clove to the right.

source.notes: Approved third six-cell handmade pencil sheet; first sheet hid the bulb contour with the clove, second was retired after the root-count plan was simplified. Both rejected sheets remain private.

final_elements.name: bulb outline
final_elements.description: One squat garlic bulb, broad at the base and tapering to the neck, at a fixed center-left position.

final_elements.name: neck and center seam
final_elements.description: A short papery neck and central curved lobe seam attached to the bulb.

final_elements.name: side lobe seams
final_elements.description: One curved seam on each side of the central lobe, stopping at the bulb base.

final_elements.name: loose clove
final_elements.description: One crescent clove resting to the lower right, separate from the bulb.

final_elements.name: roots and shadow
final_elements.description: A small tuft of short roots under the bulb and one broken ground shadow under both forms.

frames.visible_job: Draw a squat bulb outline with a narrow opening at the top.
frames.instruction: Start near the upper center, curve out to a broad left shoulder and rounded base, then rise around the right shoulder. Leave a short opening for the neck.

frames.visible_job: Join the top opening with a short neck and draw the central lobe seam.
frames.instruction: Join the two upper ends with a short jagged neck. Pull one curved center seam down from the neck to the low center of the bulb.

frames.visible_job: Add a curved side seam on each side of the central lobe.
frames.instruction: Add one bowed seam from each side of the neck toward the bulb base. Keep both inside the original outline and the central lobe widest.

frames.visible_job: Draw a separate tapered clove at the lower right.
frames.instruction: At the lower right, draw a small crescent clove with its pointed tip angled up and its blunt root end aimed toward the bulb. Leave a clear paper gap between them.

frames.visible_job: Add a small root tuft below the bulb and a broken ground shadow.
frames.instruction: Pull a small tuft of short root strokes from the bulb base. Add a broken pencil shadow under the bulb and separate clove without joining their outlines.

final_step.visible_job: Shade the established bulb lobes, clove, roots, and shadow without new structural lines.
final_step.instruction: Shade the established bulb and loose clove with soft graphite and a little warm ochre pencil. Preserve pale paper on their raised faces and deepen the existing shadow.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop provides one squat rounded bulb envelope with two open top ends; its low base, widest shoulders, and empty center make the next lobe seams easy to place.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: All six saved crops were inspected in order. The left and right bulb shoulders, center seam, paired side seams, separate lower-right clove, root tuft and broken shadow remain at consistent anchors. The clove leaves a visible gap from the bulb; the final crop shades established contours only. No temporary guides or unexplained structural losses appear.

transitions.observed_addition: The same squat bulb outline persists while a short jagged neck closes its top gap and one curved seam descends through the central lobe.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction names the jagged neck and curved central seam visible in the crop; the outer shoulders and base remain.

transitions.observed_addition: The outer bulb and central lobe remain; one bowed seam appears to the left and one to the right, both ending at the existing base.
transitions.instruction_match: The third instruction teaches the two side seams shown, with the central lobe still broad and no contour removed.

transitions.observed_addition: The bulb outline, neck, and three visible lobe seams persist. One small crescent clove appears at lower right with a clear paper gap from the bulb.
transitions.instruction_match: The fourth instruction places exactly one loose clove across a gap; its blunt root end points toward the established bulb without hiding its contour.

transitions.observed_addition: The bulb, all lobe seams, and separate crescent clove persist. A short irregular root tuft emerges below the bulb and a broken graphite shadow sits beneath both forms.
transitions.instruction_match: The fifth instruction adds the visible root tuft and broken shadow without joining or moving the two object outlines.

transitions.observed_addition: The fixed bulb, neck, center and side seams, loose clove, root tuft, and broken shadow remain; soft graphite and warm ochre now model their established surfaces.
transitions.instruction_match: The final instruction shades existing forms and deepens the same shadow; no new structural element appears.
